first_person_wrench.camera: first person at original hero feet + 1.6 game units; physical head pitch/roll; independent snap yaw
first_person_wrench.locomotion: original controller and collisions; head-relative stick; A jump/double jump; 30 degree snap turn
first_person_wrench.wrench: original mesh/animation; physical swept melee and native hit records; grip release launches native Comet-Strike, returning to tracked hand
first_person_wrench.hands: provisional glove meshes; no full-body IK
first_person_wrench.physical_validation: Pending user feedback on first-person view, hand/weapon alignment, hit and throw thresholds, and comfort

bomb_glove.control: Right trigger: press prepares one bomb, hold keeps it at the tracked right palm, tracked moving release throws it
bomb_glove.gesture: 1 m/s release threshold, tracking-space motion only, velocity gain 3, cap 18 m/s before inherited hero movement
bomb_glove.ammunition: Requires owned Bomb Glove and original ammo; native use-ammo consumes one unit only on throw, updating both mirrors before GameTick
bomb_glove.held: Original class-121 model in native dynamic renderer; NO_UPDATE and disabled passive collision suspend autonomous updates/fuse; per-render hand pose refresh
bomb_glove.flight: Native bomb::release and native scheduler, gravity, collision sweeps, fuse, water, explosion, damage, effects and audio; native passive collider remains disabled
bomb_glove.cancellation: Slow release, lost tracking/focus, menus, death or obstruction deletes the prepared bomb without using ammunition
bomb_glove.wrench: Existing grip controls preserved; the prepared bomb takes priority over held wrench/melee, while an already thrown wrench continues its native flight
bomb_glove.physical_validation: Pending user feedback on bomb visibility/alignment, trigger hold, gesture launch strength, collisions, explosions and ammo

body_hand_alignment.body: Physical horizontal HMD deltas move the original hero capsule using its world/moby collision resolver; eyes remain above resolved hero position; snap turns have no accumulated pivot translation
body_hand_alignment.synchronization: Hero moby, collision grid and render upload refreshed after room motion; no second gameplay tick or platform carry; original stick/jump velocity preserved
body_hand_alignment.tracking: Rebase after focus/menu transition; ignore tracking jumps above 0.5 m per frame; vertical head motion remains relative to calibrated eye height
body_hand_alignment.wrench: Inverse of original wrench attachment-list-0 frame aligns its authored translation and rotation with tracked palm, shared by held rendering, melee sweep, throw origin and return target

asset_inspection.source: Read-only original Novalis wrench asset inspection; held sequence 1 frame 0; not a gameplay test

body_hand_alignment.diagnostics: Runtime body_alignment and wrench_alignment messages report actual tracked transforms when available
body_hand_alignment.physical_validation: Pending user feedback in headset on body/camera collision alignment, physical movement near walls, snap turns and wrench grip/orientation

y_quick_select.binding: Left Y passes native Triangle in gameplay and menus; native context interaction priority preserved
y_quick_select.quick_select: Hold Y, select with the left stick in native menu coordinates, release to confirm; native double-tap handling preserved
y_quick_select.inventory: A fresh right-grip press requests the wrench once through the original slot swap; subsequent quick-select choices are not overwritten every tick
y_quick_select.physical_validation: Pending headset feedback on Y contextual interactions and quick-select hold/choice/release

forward_wrench_hand_select.wrench: Rotate the desired grip frame -90 degrees about controller-local X, keeping the authored grip at the palm and pointing the shaft along controller forward (-Z). Shared placement for rendering, melee, launch and native return
forward_wrench_hand_select.quick_select: Hold Y to anchor the left controller position and view plane; move the left hand toward an icon; release Y to confirm using the original ring
forward_wrench_hand_select.thresholds: 6 cm outward activation, 3.5 cm inward deactivation; project physical displacement onto the fixed view-plane right/up axes; ignore controller depth motion
forward_wrench_hand_select.tracking: Valid tracked position and HMD pose required; focus/menu/recenter resets the anchor; tracking jumps above 0.5 m rebase; snap turning paused during Y hold
forward_wrench_hand_select.isolation: Joystick ignored during Y selection. Hand direction goes only into menu analog_copy/stick_active after GameTick and before MenuFrameSet; hero locomotion receives neutral axes. Native Triangle input and contextual interaction priority retained
forward_wrench_hand_select.physical_validation: Pending headset feedback on controller-forward wrench orientation and hand-based quick-select direction/thresholds

tracked_blaster.inventory: Native GiveItem(15, equip=false) only when not owned; normal starting ammo, vendor ownership and first free quick-select slot. Existing ammo is not refilled
tracked_blaster.controls: Hold Y and move left hand to select Blaster; aim right controller; hold right trigger for native automatic fire. Fresh right grip recalls wrench
tracked_blaster.rendering: Original class-168 mesh/material/animation; authored list-0 muzzle and local -Y barrel aligned with controller forward, muzzle 40 cm ahead and 3 cm above palm
tracked_blaster.simulation: Native Blaster fire/update with optional tracked muzzle/forward, original cadence, ammo/statistics, shot class 305, collisions/damage/particles/audio; no body/camera aim assist; muzzle light/contact hits moved to muzzle
tracked_blaster.cancellation: No tracked firing on lost/blocked hand, hidden-hand/death state, pause or hand-based quick select
tracked_blaster.compatibility: Non-VR and desktop preview keep native aim; existing tracked wrench and Bomb Glove remain. Selected/requested Blaster consumes trigger edge so a held trigger cannot prepare a bomb on swap. Native animated Bomb Glove idle preparation suppressed in tracked mode to avoid duplicates
tracked_blaster.physical_validation: Pending headset feedback on Blaster grip/aim, visible projectiles, impacts/damage, cadence, ammo and weapon switching

pyrocitor_brown_hands_max_ammo.blaster_roll: Authored gun top +X mapped to controller up; corrects previous left roll without changing muzzle position/forward aim
pyrocitor_brown_hands_max_ammo.hands: Original Ratchet class-0 hand triangles/UVs/textures and native skinning; joints 75..90 left, 55..70 right; independently mounted palm frames 76/56 in a fixed pose. Procedural sphere hands removed
pyrocitor_brown_hands_max_ammo.bomb_glove: Original class-192 model replaces right brown glove while selected/preparing a bomb. Flying wrench can remain visible alongside it
pyrocitor_brown_hands_max_ammo.pyrocitor: Native item 16/class 176 granted through GiveItem, hand-aimed muzzle/forward override, original continuous flame, pilot flame, collisions, kept-flame hit spheres, damage, audio, particles and ammo consumption
pyrocitor_brown_hands_max_ammo.controls: Y plus left-hand gesture selects either gun; right controller aims and right trigger fires; fresh right grip recalls wrench. Tracking loss/obstruction/menus pause firing
pyrocitor_brown_hands_max_ammo.ammunition: Once per application launch, every owned ammo-using item is filled from its original record's +0x0e capacity; normal consumption afterward. Blaster and Pyrocitor are granted when missing and added to free quick-select slots
pyrocitor_brown_hands_max_ammo.physical_validation: Pending headset feedback on brown-glove fit/visibility, corrected gun roll, Pyrocitor flame/impacts/audio and Bomb Glove substitution
